```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet")$schema
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  collect() |>
  slice_sample(n = 10)
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  group_by(coin_id) |>
  summarise(avg_market_cap_usd = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_market_cap_usd)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")

crypto <- prices |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw)) |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(
    categories |> rename(category_description = description),
    by = "category_id"
  )
```

```{r}
metadata |>
  mutate(launch_date_parsed = as_date(parse_date_time(
    launch_date,
    orders = c("ymd", "Bdy")
  ))) |>
  select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date, launch_date_parsed) |>
  arrange(launch_date_parsed) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
prices |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = as.Date(date_raw), y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Price (USD)", title = "Bitcoin Daily Price")
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarise(
    category_market_cap_usd = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(category_name = fct_reorder(
    category_name,
    category_market_cap_usd,
    .fun = mean
  )) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  mutate(category_share = category_market_cap_usd / sum(category_market_cap_usd)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = category_share, fill = category_name)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2022-05-07"),
    xmax = as.Date("2022-05-12"),
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "grey30",
    alpha = 0.18
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2022-11-08"),
    xmax = as.Date("2022-11-11"),
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "grey30",
    alpha = 0.18
  ) +
  geom_area() +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = as.Date("2022-05-09"),
    y = 0.99,
    label = "Luna/UST crash\nMay 7-12, 2022",
    size = 3,
    linewidth = 0
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = as.Date("2022-11-09"),
    y = 0.84,
    label = "FTX collapse\nNov 8-11, 2022",
    size = 3,
    linewidth = 0
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Crypto Market-Cap Share by Category",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Daily share of combined market capitalization for the 22 tracked coins,",
      "grouped by category"
    ),
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of Combined Market Cap",
    fill = "Category",
    caption = paste(
      "Shaded windows mark the Luna/UST crash and FTX collapse.",
      "Source: PPBDS/misc.tutorials, r4ds-7 parquet data."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
